'''Condodemetraky:''' {{legend0|#7996E2|50–60%}} | title = U.S. Senator | before_election = [[Judd Gregg]] | before_party = Republican Party (United States) | after_election = [[Judd Gregg]] | after_party = Republican Party (United States) }} {{ElectionsNH}} The '''1998 United States Senate election in New Hampshire''' took place on November 3, 1998. Incumbent Republican Senator [[Judd Gregg]] ran for re-election. He won the Republican primary in a landslide over challenger Phil Weber, a State Representative, and faced the Democratic nominee, [[Belmont, New Hampshire|Belmont]] Selectman George Condodemetraky, in the general election. Gregg ultimately defeated Condodemetraky by a wide margin, winning his second term with 68% of the vote and winning every county, despite incumbent Democratic Governor [[Jeanne Shaheen]] concurrently [[1998 New Hampshire gubernatorial election|winning re-election]] with more than 66% of the vote and every county as well. ==Democratic primary== ===Candidates=== * George Condodemetraky, [[Belmont,
